Ordinary finite-group character theory proves the claimed rational isomorphism. The actual package verifier and output were checked.

value.rationale: The natural cubic-surface 27-line complex carries full W(E6) monodromy, and its previously known 26 Betti generators had no identified rational Weyl module. The determinant-twisted augmentation formula determines every homology trace, including negative root-reflection character despite 15 fixed lines; this is a structural equivariant classification with a credible geometric application to monodromy, not an arbitrarily selected coefficient or routine substitution.
